Peak Design Travel Tripod, Manfrotto Befree and Gitzo Traveler appear on most lists

ourGain.point: Load rating depends on leg angle: the 3 Legged Thing Punks Travis 2.0 is rated 18 kg at 23 degrees but 12 kg at 55 and 8 kg at 80, so low-angle setups cut capacity
Column-down height vs advertised max: the Vanguard VEO 3 GO 235CB lists 136 cm raised but 106 cm with the column down, a 30 cm gap most roundups skip
Peak Design publishes 51.25 in column-down vs 60 in raised (20 lb load, 15.5 in fold), the benchmark for usable height in a carry-on-length tripod
TSA allows tripods in both carry-on and checked bags, but the final call rests with the officer at the checkpoint; airline size limits still apply
Turn off in-body stabilization on a tripod: Sony's help guide says to turn SteadyShot off when using a tripod because it can cause a malfunction when shooting
